sections.heading: 1. Ankles and shoulders
lines: ① Single-leg balance 30 sec × 3 each side.
② Calf raises and small hops on firm ground.
③ Band rotations and rows, twice a week.
④ 5-min warm-up: jog, side shuffles, arm circles.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Toto spent all Saturday jumping on the sand. Now: heavy legs and a stiff shoulder 🏐

Soft sand shifts with every step, so calves and ankles work overtime, and spiking and serving load the back of the shoulder with every rally.

A few habits go a long way: shorter sessions while your legs adapt, single-leg balance and calf raises for your ankles, band rotations and rows for your shoulders, and a five-minute warm-up on the sand before the first game. Check the sand isn't scorching before going barefoot.

An ankle you can't stand on, a shoulder that feels unstable or swelling that keeps building is worth getting assessed. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
